# Why Yoni is spelled that way — and what it costs to get it right

There is a version of this name the early internet had to settle for: *yoni*. This is the file on how **Yoni** replaced it.

The yoni’s mythology is the Śaiva theology of the pair: the god and his power, the liṅga and its base, the still and the flowing. Its narratives are the Goddess-traditions’ own — Satī’s sacrifice, the dismembered pīṭhas, and the tantric ritual in which the base is the goddess’s body receiving the god’s libation. The word itself is the doctrine: the womb as the world’s first fact.

## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Yoni
- **ASCII form:** yoni
- **Meaning:** "'Womb, source' — the feminine principle, the origin from which all creation flows"
- **Domain of influence:** Source, Womb, Shakti
- **Pantheon:** Sanskrit
- **Restoration:** ASCII-equivalent form
- **Original script:** योनि
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 592 of 597

## The Name Before the Marks


Spoken, the name runs `/ˈjoʊni/` — “YOH-nee”

## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Yoni** lives at [/yoni/](/yoni/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/yoni/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/yoni/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/yoni/patterns/).

## Where the Name Stood First

The yoni’s monuments are the oldest Śaiva remains: the Gupta liṅgas with their carved bases, the Gudimallam ithyphallic Śiva, and the aniconic aniconism of every village shrine’s stone pair. The pīṭha-stones of Kāmākhyā are its most charged site. The temple on the web is the newest of these addresses — the first one that fits in a pocket.

## The Archetype at Work

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) seats this temple in **3 industries**, each match argued and weighted: **Wedding, Family & Maternity** (the source and womb — the feminine principle as the world's first maternity.); **Yoga, Meditation & Holistic Wellness** (the subtle-body traditions' ground — the source-principle of the esoteric anatomy.); **Philosophy, Ethics & Standards** (the material cause in Sāṃkhya — prakṛti as the matrix in which every effect pre-exists.). The [Resonance File](/yoni/blog/resonance/) reads those seats through the myths themselves.

## In the Sacred Texts

The Sanskrit tradition is not a vibe; it is a library. The [Sacred Texts collection](/texts/) holds [Rig Veda](/texts/rig-veda/) and [Ramayana](/texts/ramayana/) — the primary sources the temple's scholarship is built on. The temple is the argument; the texts are the evidence.
